sources.mix: The athletic male macro mix already used for the body sections (assets/body_cc0/section_settings.json), read from there so the two assets cannot drift.
sources.stature_m: Owner prior for the default golfer: about the PGA Tour average, 1.82 m. The runtime fit rescales each segment to the subject, so this is only the reference size of the stored mesh.
sources.quantum_m: 0.1 mm, the head asset's order of precision; int16 then spans +/-3.27 m, more than the body.
sources.weight_levels: uint8 skin weights, the hand asset's precision (1/255).
sources.max_influences: Four influences per vertex, as in assets/hand_cc0.
sources.cut_weight: A face belongs to the hands or feet when their bones carry at least half of its mean weight (the hand asset's cut); those parts and the head stay separate models.

reference_fit.source: Segment lengths between joint centres of the MuJoCo export of the tour-average driver subject at 1.82 m (hang pose), measured 2026-11-19 for the #15299 prototype. They bound how far the runtime fit has to move the stored mesh; they are not physics inputs. Scale bounds: the prototype fit scales run from 0.829 (hip spacing) to 1.120 (upper arm), and beyond the bounds the smooth weights no longer hide the stretch. Symmetry: the base mesh and the macro targets are mirror symmetric, so two quanta of slack.

budget.source: Triangle count of the uncut MakeHuman body without head, hands and feet (7,628) with headroom; the loft parts it would replace total 41,440 triangles. The byte cap keeps the asset in the size class of head_cc0.npz.
